text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain calls for joint action to safeguard Jerusalem.
- Faysal Islamic Bank posts $13.9 million profit in 1996.
- The Bahraini government donates one million Indian rupees to the Jawaharlal Nehru University in New Delhi.
- Indian airlines studying plans to increase Bahrain flights.
- Bahrain's State Security Court jails 21 suspects accused of involvement in a plot to topple the government. Another 12 acquitted.
